static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.social_status: 与同事关系因负面工作观念而紧张；在家可与配偶交流，但觉得对方not完全理解其工作相关感受
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病；既往not yet出现类似问题，not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能自我Reflection；态度中立；配合度较好；能具体描述trigger情境与自动化思维

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直感到被工作压垮并对Veterinarian的工作not快乐，尽管与动物一起工作的喜悦仍在。几个月前工作变得更紧张和更有压力后开始出现这些感受；同事离职后我承担了更多职责，压力进一步增加。大多数日子里我都有这些负面感受，尤其是早晨要去上班时。我尝试专注于工作的积极面，但仍难以克服这种阴郁感。
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these persistent negative work feelings are affecting my mental health and overall happiness, so I am seeking counseling.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough/会让他人失望
只有完美表现才算合格

special_situations.event: 每天早晨看到当天排得满满的工作日程
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能把所有任务都处理好，就说明I am not competent enough并会让他人失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces herself to focus on the positive side and raise self-demands to maintain 'perfect' standards
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not法应付这一切，我会搞砸并让大家失望

special_situations.event: 手术或程序中出现not按计划的情况
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果事情not是完全按计划进行，那就是失败，说明我能力not足
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: At work, pursues absolute perfection, doubling efforts to avoid any errors

special_situations.event: A colleague's departure leads to taking on more responsibilities and a marked increase in workload
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我without法承担额外职责，就会失败并让同事与客户失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Struggles to take on more tasks, continuously pressures oneself to meet external expectations

special_situations.event: 早晨将要赴工作、Low mood时回想工作的负面体验
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 有负面情绪时，积极的一面not重要或not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to override negative feelings with 'focusing on the positive / gratitude' (limited effect)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的工作让人沮丧，今天也会很糟

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as competent and to receive understanding and support in high-pressure environments
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and disappointing others, worrying about being criticized and relationships becoming further strained
defense_goal: 通过追求完美与高标准来确Security guard全与认可，避免显露脆弱与not确定

object_relations.self_representation: 负担过重、容易让人失望的工作者
object_relations.object_representation: Others who have high expectations of her and demand perfection (colleagues/clients/team)

manifestations: 觉得配偶not完全理解其工作相关感受
与同事关系因负面工作观念而紧张
outcomes: Decline in job satisfaction，回家后难以享受家庭时光

manifestations: Although they love interacting with animals, they are overshadowed by work pressure and gloom, finding it hard to experience the positive meaning of work
outcomes: 对工作的幸福感与Decreased sense of achievement

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Imposes on oneself the rigid demand of 'must perform perfectly'
Measures self-worth by perfect standards, ignoring the complexity and limits of reality

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: 频繁Self-doubt与自我苛责（如“我会让大家失望”）
Before facing heavy tasks, excessively scrutinizing whether one can meet the standard, causing a greater psychological burden

exception_events.target_problem: 在面对复杂手术或繁重日程时，来访者通常会预测最坏结果并感到without法应对，导致心情低落、Decreased efficiency，与同事关系受影响。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 上周一台她原本畏惧的复杂手术进行顺利，术后动物恢复Good，主人表达感谢；她感到宽慰与自豪，而非一贯的怀疑和阴郁。
exception_events.reason: 线索：由于看到客观的Good结果与他人的积极反馈（感谢与恢复），这次形成了与以往灾难化Anticipationnot同的理解与证据，从而出现了更积极的体验。

positive_force: Still loves animals and the work, and can gain joy from helping animals
具备专业胜任力（可完成复杂手术并取得Good结果）
家庭中有可倾诉的配偶作为基础支持
negative_force: 倾向灾难化、非黑即白思维、个人化、negate积极的认知模式
Introjection的完美主义高标准与持续的自我苛责
Workload increases markedly (responsibilities grow after a colleague leaves)
晨间强烈的负面情绪影响全天状态

target_behavior.behavior: 上班前出现明显的Low mood与生理压迫感（“胸口像有重物”），并伴随消极自语（如“我应付not了”“我会让大家失望”）
antecedent: 看到当天排得满满的工作日程
手术或程序中出现not按计划的情况
早晨准备去上班的情境
target_behavior.core_reason: 工作负荷骤增与Introjection的完美主义标准共同作用，诱发灾难化预测与自我贬损，从而维持负性情绪循环
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪与not确定性，通过提前Anticipation最坏获得表面的控制感并试图减少失望风险
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work efficiency、Tense relationships with colleagues，负面情绪溢出到家庭生活，难以享受家庭时光
